summary: Low-level file-read wrapper with optional text-mode newline translation, structurally a twin of sub_58AD08 (0058ad08). Reads the file handle from this+0x10, clamps the position counter at this+0x4 to non-negative, queries the cursor via sub_595F11 and returns an early cursor-delta result when the translation flags (this+0xC) do not have 0x108 set. Otherwise computes a pending byte count from the buffered range (base this+0x8 to limit this+0x0), scans for newline (10) bytes when the per-handle lowio entry (dword_8D4920) enables translation, raises TLS error 22 when the 0x80 flag is clear, and on the translation path re-queries the cursor and recounts newlines, applying an extra +1 depending on the this+0xD flag bit.

operations.description: Load the file handle from this+0x10 into v2 (retained as v19).
Guard: if the position counter at this+0x4 is negative, clamp it to 0.
sub_595F11(handle, 0, 0, 1u) queries/advances the file cursor; the 64-bit result is retained as v18 and a negative result returns -1.
Guard: when (flags at this+0xC) & 0x108 == 0 (no translation flags), return the cursor delta minus the position counter at this+0x4.
Pending byte count v20 = *(this+0x0) - *(this+0x8) (limit minus buffer base).
Guard: (flags at this+0xC) & 3 != 0 selects the text-translation path.

Guard: when the per-handle lowio table entry (dword_8D4920[handle >> 5] + 36 * (handle & 0x1F) + 4) marks text mode, scan the buffered bytes from this+0x8 up to the limit this+0x0 and add the newline (byte 10) count to the pending total.
Guard-fail path: when (flags at this+0xC) & 0x80 == 0, store error code 22 through TLSOffsetGetter() and return -1.
Guard: when the full 64-bit cursor result is zero, return the pending count v20 (end of data).
Guard: when the low bit of the flags at this+0xC is set and the position counter at this+0x4 is non-zero, compute the adjusted byte count v21 = position + limit - buffer base.
Record whether flag bit 0x20 of the byte at this+0xD is clear (v15), which drives whether the pending count is incremented by one on the translation path.

When text translation is enabled for this handle, re-query via sub_595F11(handle, 0, 0, 2u); on a match recount newline (10) bytes over the buffered range from this+0x8, otherwise reposition the cursor with sub_595F11(handle, v18 low, v18 high, 0).
